name: Seinfeld
hook: The "show about nothing" whose catchphrases, neighbors, and soup recipes became Jeopardy staples.

facts.label: the show about nothing
facts.statement: Seinfeld ran on NBC from 1989 to 1998; its finale put the four leads in prison for violating a Good Samaritan law.

facts.label: apartment 5A
facts.statement: The gang gathers in apartment 5A at 129 West 81st Street in Manhattan, with Kramer as the neighbor in 5B.

facts.label: Cosmo Kramer
facts.statement: Kramer's first name, revealed in a 1995 episode, is Cosmo.

facts.label: George Costanza
facts.statement: George Costanza, played by Jason Alexander, is the son of Jerry Stiller and Estelle Harris and once said he wanted to pretend to be an architect.

facts.label: Elaine Benes
facts.statement: Julia Louis-Dreyfus played Elaine, a copywriter for the J. Peterman catalog; she later won an Emmy for The New Adventures of Old Christine.

facts.label: the Soup Nazi
facts.statement: The Soup Nazi is Yev Kasem, based on a real New York cook, whose catchphrase is "No soup for you!"

facts.label: the puffy shirt
facts.statement: Jerry donated the puffy shirt from the season 5 episode to the Smithsonian in 2004; a low-talker designed it.
